recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this seed unless a future work group decision separately reopens the broader workflow-resource list or nutrition-boundary policy.
issue_request: The requester asked how to store nutrients for a nutrition administration and proposed a Procedure nutritionFacts backbone. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: update Procedure boundaries to say Procedure should not capture an event when a more-specific resource exists, including nutrition intake.
initial_application: The issue was applied by J#33401 commits 6f0e73e16a and 2922f045a9, merged as ece0ddd3b1 in PR #2737. Those commits changed the Procedure boundary list from an exhaustive i.e. list to an e.g. list including NutritionIntake and corrected the spelling of nutrition intake.
additional_context: OO minutes on 2023-02-10 explain that the ticket predates nutrition-specific resources and that NutritionIntake should be used when nutrition is the main focus. Current fhir.ini active resource entries include both Procedure and NutritionIntake, and NutritionIntake source includes totalIntake.nutrient, amount, and energy.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current Procedure source already contains the resolved boundary guidance, and the current NutritionIntake resource directly supports the nutrient details that motivated the request.
